_comment: The covers branch: he hid from the morning, so she comes -- knock, then her voice through the door (the first_morning_call remark; reading it is what brings her in), door, in, to the bedside. She silences the room herself (plain set_flag steps; the ambience bus does the rest -- already-off devices are no-ops), THEN says her piece at the bedside, takes the reply, and only after it is read does she turn for the door. Shares first_morning_done with mom_calls: whichever fires first silences the other.
